title: The De Luxe owned by Frank Preer, husband of Evelyn Preer
summary: After the Panama she went next door to Frank Preer's De Luxe, where Freddie Keppard played.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Because -- oh, Frank Preer (PHONETIC) owned the De Luxe. And I went to the De Luxe and that's where Freddy Keppard (PHONETIC) was.
Now, I thought Izzy Shore owned the De Luxe.
Uh-huh. No. If Izzy Shore owned it, he might have been silent partner, but I don't remember him owning it.
Frank Preer owned the De Luxe. He might have been fronting for --
-- Izzy Shore. However, Frank Preer, because he married a girl named Evelyn Preer.

Evelyn Preer, who later made a picture once, I think. I don't know what picture it was, but she made a picture. But Frank Preer was the one that had the De Luxe. And that's where I worked with -- did I say anything about the Elite Number Two?
